title: Training Data Provenance Log
description: A per-source log documenting the origin, collection method, and license status of every dataset used to train a generative model, with a recorded risk decision for any source of uncertain provenance.

history.note: Normalized US/UK spelling variants to the American-English house style (schema field names, e.g. organizations_involved, are already American; majority framework citations - NIST, FTC, EEOC, FCRA, BIPA - are American sources).

evidence_description: A structured log listing every dataset source used to train a generative model, its collection method, its license status, and — for any source of uncertain provenance — the documented risk decision (licensed, excluded, or accepted risk with rationale).
collection_method: Compiled by the model training team and reviewed by legal/compliance before commercial deployment, updated whenever a new data source is added.
retention_period: For the lifetime of the model version it documents, plus a minimum of 5 years.
artifact_format: Structured export (CSV/JSON) of per-source provenance records.

citations.title: Getty Images (US) Inc and others v Stability AI Limited [2025] EWHC 2863 (Ch)
citations.publisher: Courts and Tribunals Judiciary (England and Wales High Court)
